mainEntity.name: Can it take a fleet account's PO number?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fleet intake is part of the script: company, unit number, PO or authorization number, contact and callback. It lands in the transcript and on the job in the job system, so the repair order starts with the paperwork already done.

mainEntity.name: Does it know a hydraulic problem from a brake problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, and it does not pretend to. It captures what the caller says, in their words, and routes by the rules you set: a loaded unit down transfers to on-call, a PM request books, anything unclear takes a message and texts the caller back. Your tech reads the transcript and decides.

mainEntity.name: We do not do marketing. Why would we need a site?

acceptedAnswer.text: You probably do not need marketing.
